messages.content: User task: Help me draft a short apology email to a colleague.

raw_response:
Here's a concise, professional apology email you can adapt:

**Subject:** Apology / [Brief context, e.g., "Missed deadline" or "Miscommunication"]

Hi [Name],

I’m sorry for [specific issue — e.g., “missing yesterday’s deadline on the Q3 report” / “my unclear message in this morning’s thread”]. It impacted [you/the team] by [concrete effect — e.g., “delaying your review” / “causing confusion on next steps”], and I own that.

I’ve [corrective action — e.g., “submitted the report at 9 a.m. today” / “followed up with a clarified summary”] and will [preventive step — e.g., “set an earlier internal checkpoint” / “confirm receipt on key messages going forward”].

Thanks for your patience — I value our collaboration and will do better.

Best,  
[Your name]

---

**PLAN:**  
No tool calls needed — this is a direct writing task.
